# LolCV — Pro Resume & Career Suite for Google Gemini

[![LolCV](https://img.shields.io/badge/LolCV-1.2.0-blue.svg)](https://lolcv.com)
[![Templates](https://img.shields.io/badge/Templates-98_Total_%7C_32_Pro-purple.svg)](https://lolcv.com/cv-templates)
[![Security](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-OAuth_2.0_PKCE-green.svg)](https://lolcv.com/security)

The official **LolCV** plugin connects Google Gemini directly to your LolCV career workspace. Build ATS-compliant resumes, browse 98 templates with 32 executive Pro designs, restyle existing CVs non-destructively, craft matching cover letters, and search live vacancies across top global job boards.

---

## Key Features

- **98 ATS-Optimized Templates**: Choose from clean ATS Minimal designs to 32 featured Pro layouts (`pro-platinum`, `pro-sapphire`, `pro-gold-strategist`, `pro-mosaic-manager`, etc.).
- **Non-Destructive Restyling**: Experiment with executive designs instantly. Every restyle produces a brand-new draft copy while keeping your original CV completely unchanged.
- **Tailored CV Generation**: Formulate high-impact, ATS-keyword-optimized resumes tailored for specific job listings with explicit user approval before saving.
- **13 Cover Letter Styles**: Create matching cover letters using 13 distinct templates (Mint Professional, Noir Executive, Navy Column, Terracotta Portrait, Classic Correspondence, and more).
- **Live Vacancy Search**: Discover active jobs across European and global providers with customizable role, location, remote/work mode, and employment type filters.
- **Zero Hallucination Policy**: Grounded in authentic candidate facts. Never invents credentials, dates, or accomplishments.

---

## Starter Prompts

Try these prompts in Gemini to get started:

1. **Explore Pro Designs**:
   > *"Browse executive Pro CV templates and restyle my resume with pro-platinum."*
2. **Tailored Application Package**:
   > *"Create an ATS-friendly CV draft and matching cover letter for a Senior Software Engineer."*
3. **Job Discovery & Matching**:
   > *"Find remote software engineering jobs and tailor my resume to the vacancy."*

---

## Tool Reference

| Tool | Permission | Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `list_templates` | `cvs:read` | Browse the 98-template library with Pro and category filters |
| `search` | `cvs:read` | Find saved CVs by role or title in your account |
| `fetch` | `cvs:read` | Read one saved CV (excluding private photo binaries) |
| `create_cv_draft` | `cvs:write` | Save a new studio-compatible CV after your approval |
| `restyle_cv_draft` | `cvs:read`, `cvs:write` | Duplicate and restyle a saved CV with a Pro or standard design |
| `list_cover_letter_templates` | `cover_letters:read` | Browse 13 cover letter designs and color palettes |
| `search_cover_letters` | `cover_letters:read` | Find saved cover letters in your account |
| `fetch_cover_letter` | `cover_letters:read` | Read one saved cover letter for tailoring |
| `create_cover_letter_draft` | `cover_letters:write` | Save a new cover letter draft after your approval |
| `search_jobs` | `jobs:read` | Search real-time job openings with role and location filters |

---

## Privacy & Security

- **OAuth 2.0 PKCE Protection**: Authentication is handled via industry-standard Authorization Code with S256 PKCE.
- **Strict User Consent**: Document creation and restyling tools are only called after you explicitly approve the proposed text.
- **No Deletion or Overwriting**: LolCV is strictly append-only. No tools can delete or mutate existing documents.
- **No Unsolicited Submissions**: LolCV never submits applications or emails recruiters without your knowledge.
- **Data Isolation**: Candidate contact info is never shared with external job search providers.

For more information, visit [LolCV](https://lolcv.com) or view our [Privacy Policy](https://lolcv.com/privacy).
